note: Rosebud County zones only inside the cities of Colstrip and Forsyth (per the county's 2025 draft growth policy). Each city's code says its official zoning map is kept at City Hall; no GIS service, open-data layer or downloadable zoning polygons were found for the county, Colstrip or Forsyth. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online returned only unrelated layers (Colstrip power plant, property listers, a Billings-style zoning layer). Third-party zoning sites (zoneomics) are not official sources.
